The 70.8% accuracy on the three-class task is meaningful compared to random chance, and the drop from the four-class baseline makes sense since depth-0 human text was the easiest to classify. ## 审查报告 — d1-d3 companion metric 评估 (mvp_pipeline_pythia_002 补充)

**结论**: PASS

### 发现

- [severity: info] **方法学正确**。Worker 从 `features.jsonl` 中过滤掉 depth-0 样本，生成 `features_3class.jsonl`（15000 samples: d1=5000, d2=5000, d3=5000，depth-0=0），在此数据上重新训练分类器。这是正确做法——重新训练而非仅过滤预测结果，确保分类器学到的是 d1-d3 之间的区分而非依赖 d0 的锚定效应。

- [severity: info] **结果合理且信息量充分**。RF 3-class acc = 70.8% (CI: 69.2-72.5%), LR = 67.1%。相比 4-class 78.2% 的下降符合预期——depth-0 (recall 99%) 是最容易的类别，去掉后准确率必然下降。Pairwise AUC: d1v2=0.854, d1v3=0.957, d2v3=0.793，确认难度梯度 d2↔d3 > d1↔d2 >> d1↔d3。

- [severity: info] **支撑 Atlas/EDD narrative**。70.8% d1-d3 acc 意味着即使排除"人类 vs AI"这个简单任务，递归深度信号仍然统计可区分（远超 33.3% 随机基线）。同时 d2v3 AUC=0.793 提供了 EDD 边界的定量证据——邻近深度在 d2-d3 处开始模糊。这正是 Atlas 贡献要展示的核心发现。

- [severity: info] **Dream "d1-d5 only accuracy" 约束部分满足**。当前只有 d1-d3 (3级)，完整 d1-d5 需要 plan_011 (P1) 扩展到 depth-5。论文中需明确说明当前覆盖 d1-d3，d4-d5 留作 future work 或在 P1 阶段补充。

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run the Depth Degradation Atlas analysis pipeline.
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_atlas_analysis.sh --data_dir data/ [--output_dir artifacts/atlas/]
#   bash scripts/run_atlas_analysis.sh --data_dir data/ --single   # single dataset mode

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_DIR="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"

DATA_DIR="${PROJECT_DIR}/data"
OUTPUT_DIR="${PROJECT_DIR}/artifacts/atlas"
EDD_THRESHOLD=0.6
N_TOP=5
SEED=42
SINGLE=""

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --data_dir)      DATA_DIR="$2"; shift 2;;
        --output_dir)    OUTPUT_DIR="$2"; shift 2;;
        --edd_threshold) EDD_THRESHOLD="$2"; shift 2;;
        --n_top)         N_TOP="$2"; shift 2;;
        --seed)          SEED="$2"; shift 2;;
        --single)        SINGLE="--single"; shift;;
        -h|--help)
            echo "Usage: $0 [--data_dir DIR] [--output_dir DIR] [--edd_threshold F] [--n_top N] [--seed N] [--single]"
            exit 0;;
        *) echo "Unknown: $1"; exit 1;;
    esac
done

echo "=== Atlas Analysis Pipeline ==="
echo "Data dir:      ${DATA_DIR}"
echo "Output dir:    ${OUTPUT_DIR}"
echo "EDD threshold: ${EDD_THRESHOLD}"
echo "Top features:  ${N_TOP}"
echo ""

mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

# Activate conda if available
if [ -f /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh ]; then
    source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
    conda activate base
fi

python "${PROJECT_DIR}/src/atlas_analysis.py" \
    --data_dir "${DATA_DIR}" \
    --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
    --edd_threshold "${EDD_THRESHOLD}" \
    --n_top_features "${N_TOP}" \
    --seed "${SEED}" \
    ${SINGLE}

echo ""
echo "=== Output files ==="
ls -lh "${OUTPUT_DIR}/"

# DCOL training pipeline: data loading -> training -> evaluation -> checkpoint
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_dcol_training.sh                          # defaults
#   bash scripts/run_dcol_training.sh --gpu 1 --dry_run        # dry run on GPU 1
#   bash scripts/run_dcol_training.sh --batch_size 64 --epochs 15

set -euo pipefail

# ----- Defaults (override via CLI) -----
GPU="${GPU:-0}"
DATA_DIR="${DATA_DIR:-data/}"
OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR:-checkpoints/dcol/}"
LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-logs/}"
MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-/root/autodl-tmp/models/deberta-v3-large}"
FEATURES_PATH="${FEATURES_PATH:-data/features_all.jsonl}"
BATCH_SIZE="${BATCH_SIZE:-32}"
EPOCHS="${EPOCHS:-10}"
LR="${LR:-2e-5}"
MARGIN_LR="${MARGIN_LR:-1e-3}"
CL_WEIGHT="${CL_WEIGHT:-0.5}"
MAX_LENGTH="${MAX_LENGTH:-512}"
SEED="${SEED:-42}"
DRY_RUN=""
EXTRA_ARGS=""

# Parse command-line overrides
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --gpu)         GPU="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --data_dir)    DATA_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --output_dir)  OUTPUT_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --model_path)  MODEL_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --batch_size)  BATCH_SIZE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --epochs)      EPOCHS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --lr)          LR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --margin_lr)   MARGIN_LR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --seed)        SEED="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --dry_run)     DRY_RUN="--dry_run"; shift ;;
        *)             EXTRA_ARGS="$EXTRA_ARGS $1"; shift ;;
    esac
done

# ----- Environment -----
PROJ_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$PROJ_ROOT"

# Conda activation (AutoDL aml-train image)
if [ -f /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh ]; then
    source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
    conda activate base
fi

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
export HF_HOME="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"

# ----- Directories -----
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"

# ----- Check model availability -----
if [ ! -d "$MODEL_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Model not found at $MODEL_PATH"
    echo "[INFO] Will download from HuggingFace (microsoft/deberta-v3-large)"
    # Enable network acceleration on AutoDL
    if [ -f /etc/network_turbo ]; then
        source /etc/network_turbo
        export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
    fi
    MODEL_PATH="microsoft/deberta-v3-large"
fi

# ----- Check features -----
FEAT_FLAG=""
if [ -f "$FEATURES_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Using pre-computed features: $FEATURES_PATH"
    FEAT_FLAG="--features_path $FEATURES_PATH"
fi

# ----- Run training -----
echo "============================================"
echo " DCOL Training Pipeline"
echo " GPU:         $GPU"
echo " Data:        $DATA_DIR"
echo " Model:       $MODEL_PATH"
echo " Batch size:  $BATCH_SIZE"
echo " Epochs:      $EPOCHS"
echo " LR:          $LR (margin: $MARGIN_LR)"
echo " CL weight:   $CL_WEIGHT"
echo " Output:      $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo " Dry run:     ${DRY_RUN:-no}"
echo "============================================"

python src/dcol_trainer.py \
    --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
    --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
    --output_dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --log_dir "$LOG_DIR" \
    --batch_size "$BATCH_SIZE" \
    --epochs "$EPOCHS" \
    --lr "$LR" \
    --margin_lr "$MARGIN_LR" \
    --cl_weight "$CL_WEIGHT" \
    --max_length "$MAX_LENGTH" \
    --gpu 0 \
    --seed "$SEED" \
    $FEAT_FLAG \
    $DRY_RUN \
    $EXTRA_ARGS

TRAIN_EXIT=$?
if [ $TRAIN_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "[ERROR] Training failed with exit code $TRAIN_EXIT"
    exit $TRAIN_EXIT
fi

# ----- Run evaluation (skip for dry run) -----
if [ -z "$DRY_RUN" ] && [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/best_model.pt" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "============================================"
    echo " Running evaluation..."
    echo "============================================"

    python src/dcol_eval.py \
        --checkpoint "$OUTPUT_DIR/best_model.pt" \
        --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
        --output_dir "results/dcol/" \
        --gpu 0 \
        --eval_mode all \
        $FEAT_FLAG

    echo ""
    echo "[DONE] Training + evaluation complete."
    echo "  Checkpoint: $OUTPUT_DIR/best_model.pt"
    echo "  Results:    results/dcol/dcol_eval_results.json"
else
    echo ""
    echo "[DONE] Training complete."
    echo "  Checkpoint: $OUTPUT_DIR/"
fi

    def __init__(self, model_name, feature_dim=19, embed_dim=128,

        embeddings = self.head(cls_hidden, features)
        logits = self.classifier(embeddings)
        return embeddings, logits


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def contrastive_ordinal_loss(embeddings, depths, margins_module, strategies=None):
    """
    Multi-margin contrastive ordinal loss (vectorized).

    For each anchor i with depth d_i, computes:
        L_i = mean_{j: d_j != d_i} max(0, M(d_i, d_j) + sim(i, j) - mean_pos_sim(i))

    where mean_pos_sim(i) = mean cosine similarity to same-depth samples.
    M(d_i, d_j) is the effective learnable margin, monotonically increasing with |d_i - d_j|.

    All operations are differentiable through the margin parameters.
    """
    B = embeddings.size(0)
    device = embeddings.device

    if B < 2:
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)

    # Cosine similarity (embeddings are L2-normalized)
    sim = torch.matmul(embeddings, embeddings.t())  # (B, B)

    eye = torch.eye(B, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    same_depth = (depths.unsqueeze(1) == depths.unsqueeze(0)) & ~eye
    diff_depth = depths.unsqueeze(1) != depths.unsqueeze(0)

    valid = same_depth.any(dim=1) & diff_depth.any(dim=1)
    if not valid.any():
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)

    # Mean positive similarity per anchor
    same_f = same_depth.float()
    pos_sim = (sim * same_f).sum(dim=1) / same_f.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1)  # (B,)

    # Build margin matrix M[i, j] using cumsum trick
    if margins_module.strategy_names is not None and strategies is not None:
        # Per-strategy margins
        all_adj = F.softplus(margins_module.raw_margins)           # (S, K-1)
        eff_all = margins_module.build_effective_matrix(all_adj)   # (S, K, K)
        strat_idx = torch.tensor(
            [margins_module.strategy_to_idx.get(s, 0) for s in strategies],
            device=device,
        )
        # Gather per-anchor: (B, K, K) from (S, K, K) indexed by strat_idx
        anchor_eff = eff_all[strat_idx]                            # (B, K, K)
        arange_B = torch.arange(B, device=device)
        margin_matrix = anchor_eff[
            arange_B.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, B),
            depths.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, B),
            depths.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, B),
        ]
    else:
        adj = margins_module.get_adj_margins()                     # (K-1,)
        eff = margins_module.build_effective_matrix(adj)           # (K, K)
        margin_matrix = eff[depths.unsqueeze(1), depths.unsqueeze(0)]  # (B, B)

    # Loss: max(0, margin + neg_sim - pos_sim)
    raw_loss = F.relu(margin_matrix + sim - pos_sim.unsqueeze(1))  # (B, B)
    loss_mask = diff_depth & valid.unsqueeze(1)
    total = (raw_loss * loss_mask.float()).sum()
    count = loss_mask.float().sum().clamp(min=1)

    return total / count

import json
import os
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, Sampler
from collections import defaultdict
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

FEATURE_NAMES = [
    "mean_ppl", "var_ppl", "skewness_ppl", "kurtosis_ppl",
    "p10_ppl", "p25_ppl", "p50_ppl", "p75_ppl", "p90_ppl",
    "mean_surprisal", "var_surprisal", "entropy_of_surprisal",
    "type_token_ratio", "hapax_ratio", "bigram_entropy", "trigram_entropy",
    "rep_2gram", "rep_3gram", "rep_4gram",
]
NUM_FEATURES = len(FEATURE_NAMES)


def parse_model_strategy(dirname):
    """
    Infer model and decoding strategy from subdirectory name.
    "gpt2xl" -> (gpt2xl, default), "pythia_temp09" -> (pythia, temp09)
    """
    if dirname.startswith("pythia_"):
        return "pythia", dirname[len("pythia_"):]
    return dirname, "default"


def load_features(features_path):
    """Load pre-computed 19-dim features from JSONL. Returns list aligned with extraction order."""
    features = []
    with open(features_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            row = json.loads(line)
            features.append([row[k] for k in FEATURE_NAMES])
    return features


def load_all_data(data_dir, features_path=None):
    """
    Load text data from all model/strategy directories.

    Root data/depth_*.jsonl -> model=pythia, strategy=default.
    Subdirectories data/{name}/depth_*.jsonl -> model/strategy parsed from name.

    If features_path is given, the 19-dim features are attached to root-directory

        with open(fpath) as f:

                    continue

**Architecture**: Feature-based MLP (no DeBERTa):
- Encoder: 19 → 128 (BN, ReLU, Dropout) → 64 (BN, ReLU, Dropout)
- Projection head: 64 → 32 (L2-normalized)
- Classifier: 64 → 4

**Loss**: N-pair contrastive ordinal loss with CE:
- L_attractive: pulls same-depth samples together (squared Euclidean distance on L2-normalized projections)


- L_repulsive: pushes different-depth samples apart with margin proportional to ordinal distance (beta * |d_i - d_j|)
- L_CE: standard cross-entropy

The key insight is that ordinal structure gets encoded through fixed margins scaled by depth differences — larger depth gaps require larger separations in the N-pair formulation. Compared to `dcol_trainer.py`, this version uses fixed rather than learnable margins and operates on raw 19-dimensional features without any transformer backbone.

3. Final evaluation: `final = evaluate(model, test_loader, ...)` → report metrics on same test set

The model checkpoint was selected to minimize test loss, so the final test metrics are optimistically biased. This is a classic mistake.

Good. `dcol_dataset.py` has a `split_data` function that does a proper 3-way split (train/val/test). The DeBERTa-based `dcol_trainer.py` uses this correctly.

But `dcol_train.py` (the feature-based version) does NOT use this 3-way split — it only does `train_test_split` once (2-way), then uses the test set for both early stopping and final evaluation.

This is a **critical** issue because:
1. DCOL's reported accuracy will be optimistically biased
2. The comparison with RF (78.2%) will be unfair — RF used the same 80/20 split but without early stopping, so RF's test metric is unbiased


3. If this biased metric makes it into the paper, reviewers will definitely spot it

This is exactly the kind of issue I should flag as critical — it could fundamentally skew the conclusions about DCOL's effectiveness. I need to bring this to the Director's attention.

## 审查报告 — Feature-based DCOL (`dcol_train.py`)

**结论**: WARNING（整体设计良好，一个数据泄漏问题需修复后才能运行）

### 发现

- [severity: critical] **验证集 / 测试集未分离——数据泄漏**。`dcol_train.py:527` 只做了一次 `train_test_split`（2-way split），产出 `X_train` 和 `X_test`。然后训练循环中 `line 574: val_m = evaluate(model, test_loader, ...)` 用 test set 做 early stopping，最终评估 `line 617: final = evaluate(model, test_loader, ...)` 又在同一个 test set 上报告指标。模型 checkpoint 是按 test loss 选的，所以报告的 test accuracy 有上偏。与之对比，DeBERTa 版 `dcol_trainer.py` 通过 `dcol_dataset.split_data()` 做了正确的 3-way split（train/val/test）。**修复方案**：在 `dcol_train.py` 中也做 3-way split（例如 train 70% / val 15% / test 15%），用 val set 做 early stopping，test set 仅用于最终评估。否则 DCOL vs RF 的比较不公平（RF 的 80/20 split 没有 early stopping，指标无偏）。

- [severity: info] **N-pair contrastive ordinal loss 实现正确**。`DCOLLoss.forward` 遍历所有 (i,j) 对：正对 (same depth) 拉近，负对 (diff depth) 以 β·|d_i−d_j| 为 margin 推远。margin 线性于序数距离，编码了深度的有序结构。满足 Dream "full N-pair" 约束。

- [severity: info] **Feature-based 策略合理**。MLP (19→128→64→proj32/cls4) 与 RF 在同一特征空间上对比，消除了表示差异。如果 feature-based DCOL 优于 RF，说明 contrastive ordinal loss 本身有价值（不仅是 DeBERTa 带来的增益）。这是一个干净的 ablation。

- [severity: info] **BalancedDepthSampler 确保每 batch 都有各深度的样本**——contrastive loss 的正确性依赖于 batch 内有正负对，这个 sampler 保证了这一点。

- [severity: info] **评估全面**：4-class acc + CI、3-class d1-d3 acc、pairwise AUC、confusion matrix、embedding 可视化、与 RF baseline 自动比较。

### 建议

1. **[必须]** 修复 3-way split 后再运行 DCOL 实验，否则结果不可用于论文。
2. DeBERTa 版 `dcol_trainer.py` 已有正确的 3-way split，可直接参考 `dcol_dataset.split_data()` 的实现。
